```python
"""Additional tests for reports.export.export_csv."""
import unittest

from reports import export_csv


class ExportCsvExtraTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_generator_rows_and_columns(self):
        rows = iter([{"a": 1, "b": 2}])
        cols = iter(["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, cols), "a,b\r\n1,2\r\n")

    def test_empty_columns(self):
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([{"a": 1}], []), "\r\n")

    def test_none_and_missing(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            export_csv([{"a": None, "b": 1}], ["a", "b", "c"]),
            "a,b,c\r\n,1,\r\n"
        )

    def test_embedded_newlines(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            export_csv([{"a": "line1\nline2\r\nline3"}], ["a"]),
            'a\r\n"line1\nline2\r\nline3"\r\n'
        )

    def test_unicode(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            export_csv([{"a": "café ☕"}], ["a"]),
            "a\r\ncafé ☕\r\n"
        )

    def test_duplicate_columns_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], ["a", "a"])

    def test_non_string_columns_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([], [1])

    def test_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        rows = [{"a": 1, "b": 2}]
        cols = ["a"]
        export_csv(rows, cols)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [{"a": 1, "b": 2}])
        self.assertEqual(cols, ["a"])

    def test_ignore_unselected_fields(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            export_csv([{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}], ["a", "c"]),
            "a,c\r\n1,3\r\n"
        )

    def test_quote_doubling(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            export_csv([{"a": 'he said "hi"'}], ["a"]),
            'a\r\n"he said ""hi"""\r\n'
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
